body.description: BatchInputPublicFetchAssociationsBatchRequest. Read-only batch read of the associations from each input record to toObjectType. Authorization carries Bearer authentication with the server-side HubSpot access token, whose value never appears in a contract; Content-Type is application/json.

inputs.description: At most limits.max_inputs (1,000) inputs per call, the batch-read limit in the associations guide. The schema subset has no maxItems, so the request validator and the connector enforce the bound. The initial call sends {id} only. A continuation re-sends {id, after} for each input whose result returned paging.next.after, carrying that input's own cursor; a cursor is never sent on another input or outside its input.

items.description: PublicFetchAssociationsBatchRequest: one record whose associations are read.

id.description: Id of the record whose associations are fetched, sent as a string.

after.description: Paging cursor from this same input's previous result (paging.next.after). Absent on the initial call.

body.description: BatchResponsePublicAssociationMultiWithLabel on 200; BatchResponsePublicAssociationMultiWithLabelWithErrors on 207, which adds errors and numErrors. In a 207, failed inputs are absent from results and identified by errors. An error with NO_ASSOCIATIONS_FOUND in category or in subCategory ('crm.associations.NO_ASSOCIATIONS_FOUND') is the empty-association exception: that input's fetch is ok_empty, a genuine zero. Every other input error makes that input's fetch error. A continuation that fails after earlier pages of an input were read makes that input's fetch partial. Reads of the associated targets are a separate surface, so this contract does not resolve target-read failures. documented_sample is the reference page's rendered 207 example, kept verbatim with its placeholders; its CANCELED status makes it a failed call, not an application-success fixture.

status.description: Batch processing state. Only COMPLETE is a successful call. CANCELED, PENDING and PROCESSING are failed calls even when the body is schema-valid.

results.description: One entry per input that succeeded on this call.

items.description: PublicAssociationMultiWithLabel: the associations of one input that succeeded. An empty to array is a genuine zero for that input (ok_empty).

id.description: Id of the input record, matching the request input's id.

to.description: Associated target records on this page.

toObjectId.description: Id of the associated target record. The reference schema and sample give a string; the associations guide and live responses give a JSON number (an integer id). Both are admitted, and the parser normalises the id to a string.

associationTypes.description: Every association type linking the source record to this target.

items.description: AssociationSpecWithLabel: the type and label of one association to the target record.

category.description: Association type category, as enumerated by the reference schema.

typeId.description: Unique identifier of the association type.

label.description: Association label. Null for an unlabeled association, as the associations guide's examples and simulated responses return it; a string for a labeled one.

fromObjectTypeId.description: Object type id of the source record. The reference schema and sample give a string; live 2026-09 responses return null (observed by a live capture, 2026-10). Both are admitted, and the parser does not read it.

toObjectTypeId.description: Object type id of the target record. The reference schema and sample give a string; live 2026-09 responses return null (observed by a live capture, 2026-10). Both are admitted, and the parser does not read it.

paging.description: Present only when this input has more pages; absent once its associations are fully read. No paging key is required on a finished result.

after.description: Cursor re-sent as {id, after} for this result's input only.

link.description: Deprecated by HubSpot and ignored by the connector.

prev.description: PreviousPage. Defined by the reference schema; the connector does not page backwards.

link.description: Deprecated by HubSpot and ignored by the connector.

startedAt.description: When batch processing began, ISO 8601 date-time.

completedAt.description: When batch processing completed, ISO 8601 date-time.

requestedAt.description: When the batch request was made, ISO 8601 date-time.

links.description: Open map: HubSpot chooses the link names of this server-defined documentation map, each mapped to a URL.

errors.description: 207 only: one entry per failed input.

items.description: StandardError: one failed input of a 207 multi-status response. Only status, category and message are required, because live per-input errors can omit the context, errors and links the reference schema marks required.

status.description: Error status, for example 'error' in live responses.

category.description: Main error category. A live input with no associations carries OBJECT_NOT_FOUND here with subCategory 'crm.associations.NO_ASSOCIATIONS_FOUND'; a category of NO_ASSOCIATIONS_FOUND is recognised as the same empty case.

message.description: Human-readable description of the error and possible remediation.

id.description: Unique id of the error instance.

subCategory.description: Live responses carry a string identifier such as 'crm.associations.NO_ASSOCIATIONS_FOUND'. The reference schema types it as an object with no declared properties and its generated sample renders it as {}, so the object variant is open.

context.description: Open map: HubSpot chooses the keys per error, for example fromObjectId listing the input ids that have no associations. Values are lists of strings in the reference schema.

links.description: Open map: HubSpot chooses the link names, each mapped to a documentation URL.

errors.description: Detailed error objects for this input.

items.description: ErrorDetail: one detail of a failed input.

code.description: Status code associated with the detail.

context.description: The reference sample renders it as the string '{missingScopes=[scope1, scope2]}', kept as a string. The reference schema types it as an object map whose keys HubSpot chooses per error, so the object variant is open.

in.description: Field or parameter in which the error was found.

subCategory.description: More specific category of the detail.
